items.reason: pkg/server/module_server_test.go:36-37 unconditionally skips PostgreSQL before the storage-server startup and metrics assertions at lines 47-63. This removes PostgreSQL integration coverage while pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:258 changes startup initialization, creating a real test coverage gap without establishing what caused the Drone failure.

Eager initialization at pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:258 is real, but callers already handle constructor errors, including pkg/storage/unified/sql/server.go:77-79 and pkg/storage/unified/client.go:67-74. Repeated Init calls are protected by sync.Once at pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:294; the comment identifies no broken caller or contract requiring lazy initialization.
